Ava: Quick regional bench: L4 vs T4 vs A10G for embed-small & small-chat. TL;DR: embeddings -> T4 best $/embed, L4 good latency/throughput tradeoff, A10G overkill for most embed traffic; small-chat -> A10G wins latency, L4 competitive when quantized. Sheet + charts: https://go/sheets/bench-1845 :point_right:

Marco: Can you paste p50/p95 and cost-per-1M here? ops needs numbers for capacity planning.

Ava: Pasted minimal numbers (batching/seq stated). Ran across us-west1 / eu-west1 / ap-southeast1, model variants: embed-small (seq=128) and chat-small (max_out=256). Command we used:
```
rbench run --model embed-small --gpu L4 --region us-west1 --batch 256 --seq 128 --quant q4f16
rbench run --model chat-small --gpu A10G --region us-west1 --max-toks 256 --quant fp16
```
Embeddings (batch=256, seq=128) us-west1:
- L4: p50=7ms, p95=28ms, throughput=14k embeds/s, cost/1M embeds ≈ $1.9
- T4: p50=12ms, p95=45ms, throughput=8.5k embeds/s, cost/1M embeds ≈ $1.3
- A10G: p50=5ms, p95=18ms, throughput=20k embeds/s, cost/1M embeds ≈ $4.0

Small-chat (max_out=256, temp=0.7) us-west1:
- L4 (q4f16): p50=48ms, p95=140ms, tokens/s≈1200, cost/1M toks ≈ $2.5
- T4 (q4f16): p50=90ms, p95=300ms, tokens/s≈700, cost/1M toks ≈ $1.9
- A10G (fp16): p50=32ms, p95=95ms, tokens/s≈1800, cost/1M toks ≈ $6.8

Notes: eu-west1 was ~+10-18% p95 vs us-west1; ap-southeast1 had ~+20-25% depending on instance. Quant: q4f16 boosted throughput ~1.4-1.7x vs fp16 on L4/T4 with negligible topo quality drop for small-chat; q2 configs started to show hallucination + lower BLEU. Kernel choices:
- L4: triton-fused-attn gave ~10-20% p50 improvement for chat workloads vs default kernels.
- A10G: cutlass/cuBLAS kernels were best for fp16 throughput; switching to triton fused helped latency slightly for short sequences.
- T4: more sensitive to batch sizing; smaller batches reduce p95 but drop utilization.

Sanjay: Nice. For capacity planning — how many concurrent RPS per GPU for 95th p95 SLO=200ms?

Ava: Rough rules of thumb (small-chat, avg request ~500 tokens output):
- A10G ~1800 tok/s => ~3.6 requests/s at 500 tokens (rounded ~3-4 rps) but higher headroom given p95 headroom => we provision ~6-9 rps per GPU in practice for bursty workloads.
- L4 ~1200 tok/s => ~2.4 rps (practically provision 5-7 rps per GPU with q4f16).
- T4 ~700 tok/s => ~1.4 rps (provision 3-4 rps).
For embeddings use-case (1k-embed batch patterns): L4 handled ~14k/s so you can serve ~14M embeddings per 1000s of GPU time unit — check sheet for per-region pricing.

Priya: Can you add kernel/quant config snapshot to the sheet so we can reproduce? CC @InfraBot for normalized infra pricing by region.

InfraBot: Noted. I'll ingest the bench CSV, add instance pricing for us/eu/apac, and post normalized cost-per-1M for each region. Will flag where L4/T4 break-even points are per workload.
